segments.subtask: The robot is positioned near the white bowl, preparing to interact with it.
The robot grasps the spoon and begins to scoop contents from the white bowl.
The robot lifts the spoon with contents and moves it towards the green bowl.
The robot pours the contents from the spoon into the green bowl.
The robot places the spoon back into the white bowl and prepares for the next action.
The robot grasps the spoon again and scoops more contents from the white bowl.
The robot lifts the spoon with contents and moves it towards the green bowl.
The robot pours the contents from the spoon into the green bowl.
The robot places the spoon back into the white bowl and completes the task.
